t: Din hayyotze ladderek upoalim mah yitpalelu veseder tepillat hadderek ubet hammidrash
s: Din hayyotze ladderek upoalim mah yitpalelu veseder tepillat hadderek ubet hammidrash ubo yu"d seipim: bishat haddechaq shei epshar lo lehitpallel shemoneh esreh berakot, kegon shehashshaa oberet, o shehu badderek veyare shemma yapsiquhu obere derakim im yitpallel kol shemoneh esreh berakot derek hilluko o meyushshab o meummad kemo shennitbaer besiman tz", o sheomed bemaqom shehu tarud veyare shemma yapsiquhu, o shello yukal lehitpallel tepilla arukka bekavvana mechamat tirdat dato — mitpallel meen shemoneh esreh, shehu tepillat "habinenu" shekkolelet kol y"g berakot emtzaiyyot vechotem be"shomea tepilla". Vetzarik lomar lepaneha g' berakot rishonot ketiqnan uleachareha g' acharonot ketiqnan. Vetzarik leomran kullan meummad, veeno yakol leomran derek hilluko badderek, kemo shehittiru bitpillat shemoneh esreh kede shello yittared libbo beikkub darko velo yukal lekavven kemo shennitbaer sham, lepi shekkevan shemmitpallel tepilla qetzara meen y"ch lo yittared kol kak baamidato. Ukesheyyaggia lebeto — en tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel y"ch, hoil ukebar amar meen y"ch. Veeno mitpallel "habinenu" lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shetztzarik lomar sheela be"birkat hashshanim", velo bemotzae shabbat veyom tob mippene shetztzarik lomar habdala be"chonen haddaat" (veen lo lekolelan ba"habinenu" lomar bah meen habdala usheela, lepi shehashsheela vehabdala enan berakot bipne atzman ella tiqqenu lekolelan bebirkot y"ch, sheela be"birkat hashshanim" vehabdala bebirkat "chonen haddaat", veim haya omer ba"habinenu" meen habdala usheela — haya nireh shehen gam ken berakot bipne atzman kemo kol berakot haemtzaiyyot sheomer meen kol achat veachat ba"habinenu"[)]:

Happoalim sheosim melaka etzel baal habbayit im eno noten lahem sakar chutz misseudatan — mitpalelin y"ch berakot shelemot. Abal en yoredin lipne hatteba veen nosein kappehem, mishshum bittul melakto shel baal habbayit. Veim noten lahem sekar peullatam lebad seudatam — tzerikim lemaher hammelaka umitpalelin meen y"ch. Veakshav en derek baal habbayit lehaqpid bekak, umin hassetam al daat ken sokerin otam sheyyitpalelu y"ch. Vehu haddin sheyyeleku lebet hakkeneset lehitpallel baasara, bemaqom sheen derek baal habbayit lehaqpid bekak:

Haholek bimqom gedude chayya velistim — mitpallel tepilla qetzara, shehu "tzorke ammeka merubbim ku'" vechotem be"shomea tepilla", veen tzarik lo leg' rishonot velo leg' acharonot. Umitpallel keshehu mehallek. Veim yakol laamod — omed. Ukesheyyaggia leyishshub vetitbarer dato — tzarik lehitpallel tepillat y"ch ketiqnah im lo abar zemannah ap al pi shehitpallel tepilla qetzara meummad, hoil velo amar bah apillu meen y"ch. Veim shakach o sheabar zemannah — dino keshokeach velo hitpallel legamre, shetztzarik lehashlim otah bizman tepilla shelleachareha, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"ch:

Hayyotze ladderek — tzarik lehitpallel tepillat hadderek shehi "yehi ratzon millepaneka Hashem eloqenu veloqe abotenu shettolikenu leshalom veku'". Veap im holek yechidi yomrenna bilshon rabbim, shemmittok kak tepillato nishmaat. Veim ba lehosip bah dibre ritztzuy — yakol leomram bilshon yachid, kevan sheeno mimmatbea habberaka sheqqabeu choba larabbim (veyesh mi sheomer sheal pi hassod yesh lomar millat "uteneni lechen" bilshon yachid ap al pi shehu mimmatbea habberaka haqqabua larabbim). Umin haddin yakol lomar tepillat hadderek apillu keshehu mehallek, ella mishshum "mihyot tob al tiqqare ra" — yaamod kesheyyomrenna im epshar lo, kegon shebbene hashshayyara gam ken omedim. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik laamod ella millelek, abal im haya rakub en tzarik lered ella yaamid habbehema millelek im epshar lo, sheim yirkob hare hu kimhallek (vehu haddin leyosheb baagala sheen tzarik lered ella lehaamid hassusim im epshar lo):

En tzarik lomar tepillat hadderek ella paam achat bekol yom shehu holek, vaapillu im yanuach bair beemtza hayyom vechozer laleket mimmenna lehalea o lashub lebeto. Abal im dato lalun bair veachar kak nimlak veyatza mimmenna laabor chutza lah o lashub lebeto — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel otah paam acheret keillu kebar lan bah (shekken hu bekol habberakot shekkeshehu nimlak tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"v):

Meematay mitpallel otah? Mishshaa shemmehallek badderek, abal lo kesheadayin hu betok hair sheddar bah, lepi sheen lehitpallel tepillat hadderek ad sheyyachaziq badderek. Veibburah shel ir, dehaynu a' amma veshirayim samuk lair — hare hu ketok lair. Veyesh mi shemmattir apillu betok hair, mishshaa sheggamar belibbo vehekin atzmo latzet bo bayyom, shezzeh niqra gam ken hecheziq badderek shemmuchzaq lelek bevadday. Veyesh lismok al debarayv bediabad (uledibre hakkol keshehu badderek yakol leomrah betok hair shellan bah, kevan shekkebar hecheziq veholek badderek veodennu machaziq bah, shebbeir zo eno ella oreach nata lalun):

Tepillat hadderek chotemet be"baruk" veenah potachat be"baruk", lepi sheenah ella baqqashat rachamim. Veap al pi ken tob lehasmikah leezo beraka, kede shettihyeh beraka hassemuka lachabertah sheen tzarik liptoach be"baruk", kegon im holek babboqer — yasmikenna lebirkat "haggomel chasadim tobim leammo yisrael" im mebarek birkat hashshachar leachar shehecheziq badderek kemo shennitbaer, veim holek beemtza hayyom — yokal o yishteh keshiur sheyyebarek beraka acharona, o yatil mayim vibarek "asher yatzar" veachar kak yatchil miyyad "yehi ratzon millepaneka ku'":

Lo tiqqenu tepillat hadderek ella kesheyyesh lo lelek parsa, shehi ch' alapim amma, sheppachot mipparsa beqerub lair — eno meqom sakkana min hassetam. Veim rotzeh leomrah al derek pachot mipparsa — lo yachtom be"baruk (atta Hashem)". Abal im hu maqom muchzaq besakkana — tzarik leomrah apillu bepachot mipparsa. Veyesh omerim shello tiqqenu tepillat hadderek ella bitchillat hadderek shehi parsa rishona. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla leomrah beparsa rishona. Veim shakach milleomrah — yomar otah kol zeman shehu badderek, ubilbad shello higgia letok parsa hassemuka lair sherotzeh lalun bah, umishsham veelak yomar otah belo beraka:

Hayyotze ladderek — tob sheyyittol reshut miggedole hair ap al pi sheenam rabbotayv kede sheyyebarekuhu, veal yomru lo "lek beshalom" ella "lek leshalom", shehare yitro sheamar lemosheh "lek leshalom" — ala vehitzliach, vedavid sheamar leabshalom "lek beshalom" — halak venitla. Ukeshehu badderek — yaasoq battora (shenneemar: "ubelekteka badderek"). Velo yaasoq beiyyun halaka, shello yiteh badderek, ella im ken yosheb baagala veish acher manhig hassusim. Veal yokal badderek yoter mishshiur akilat shene reabon, mishshum choli meayim, ella im ken yosheb bispina (vekayyotze) bah. Ukeshenniknas lair lalun — yikkanes be"ki tob" veyetze be"ki tob", shemma yippol beachat happechatim. Abal samuk leiro shehu yodea lehizzaher sham mehappechatim — yakol lelek sham ballayla, im eno holek yechidi sheen lachosh lammazziqim:

Hanniknas lebet hammidrash — tzarik lehitpallel biknisato shello yeera debar taqqala al yado, ubitziato — tzarik litten hodaa al chelqo. Biknisato mah hu omer: "yehi ratzon millepaneka Hashem eloqenu veloqe abotenu shello ekkashel bidbar halaka ku'". Vehu haddin mi sheyyosheb lilmod bichidut, ubiprat im higgia lehoraa — tzarik lehitpallel shello yiteh belimmud ubehoraa lomar al tame tahor veal asur muttar. Vetob lomar nussach echad qatzar kolel harbeh, vezehu: "yehi ratzon millepaneka Hashem eloqenu veloqe abotenu, shettair enay bimor torateka vehatztzileni mikkol mikshol vetaut, hen bedine issur vehetter, hen bedine mamonot, hen behoraa, hen belimmud, gal enay veabbita niplaot mittorateka, umah sheshshagiti kebar haamideni al haemet, veal tatztzel mippi debar emet ad meod, ki Hashem yitten chokma mippiv daat utebuna" (ukeshellomed bachabura — tzarik lebaqqesh gam ken shello yismach betaqqalatam velo yismechu betaqqalato). Bitziato mah hu omer: "modeh ani ku'". Vehu haddin haoseq battora bichidut, tzarik lomar ken bekol ereb achar gemar limmudo (im lamad kol hayyom):
